title: Reduced-size cross-feeding reference: box +-60 um (0.36 of the area), half-size cluster (111 cells = 0.31 of the cells, same density), dx 1.25, dz 1.25, dt 0.001, 1800 min, seed 50
question: Reference of the reduced-size convergence series
observables: alive cells and mean growth rate of each species at 600/1200/1800 min; time of the first doubling of M. barkeri; sign and median of the acetate, H2, CO2 and glucose exchange of each species; median H2 and acetate concentration in the cells' voxels; cap fraction and median cap ratio (recorded bound / Michaelis-Menten bound) per substrate; ledger residual
rationale: The full system (200 x 200 um, 353 cells) costs 9.5 h per run on one node at this setting; the reduced size (0.36 of the area, 0.31 of the cells) is for qualitative patterns, nutrient exchange and sequential growth, and a numerical dx / dt series. The boundary is Dirichlet on all faces (H2 = 0 at the box edge), so a smaller box brings the sink closer: the reduced reference is not the paper figure. SUBMITTED

title: Voxel size dx = dy 0.8 and 1.6 um at dt 0.001 (dz stays 1.25)
question: Does the qualitative pattern and the growth depend on dx at the reference dt?
observables: alive cells and mean growth rate of each species at 600/1200/1800 min; time of the first doubling of M. barkeri; sign and median of the acetate, H2, CO2 and glucose exchange of each species; median H2 and acetate concentration in the cells' voxels; cap fraction and median cap ratio (recorded bound / Michaelis-Menten bound) per substrate; ledger residual
criterion: Qualitative, fixed before the runs: both species grow, C. beijerinckii takes glucose and releases acetate / H2 / CO2, M. barkeri takes acetate / H2, and M. barkeri growth follows C. beijerinckii growth, in every run. Quantitative: cell number of each species at 1800 min within max(10%, 2 x seed spread of CF-SEED) of the finest step of the series
rationale: Earlier (pre-pin, full box) series: dx 1.25 and 1.6 agree at dt 0.001, dx 0.8 is 10-18% lower because H2 uptake is capped. dz is held at 1.25 um so that the medium depth per unit area does not change with dx (the shipped 2D configs tie dz to dx). SUBMITTED
